cards.title: Gravity Light
cards.operation: Einstein metric normal form · local null light directions
cards.relation: On every chosen Lorentzian two-plane (Pₓ, gₓ), Aₗₒᵣᵀη₁,₁Aₗₒᵣ = G = [Q, Ω] is an exact normal form of Einstein’s metric interval ds² = gμνdxμdxν, and zᵀGz = 0 gives its two local null light directions. [GL.0, GL.10–GL.11b]
cards.result: The root boost preserves this metric: LₛᵀGLₛ = G. Under the local inclusion, gₓ(ιₓℓ±, ιₓℓ±) = 0 gives the physical null directions.

cards.title: Memory Motion
cards.equation: Tₐ←ᵦTᵦ←ₐ = I,  ξₗᵢ𝒻ₜ(Lₐₓz) = ξₗᵢ𝒻ₜ(z) + 2 log φ
cards.relation: An invertible time-addressed transport obeys Tₐ←ᵦTᵦ←ₐ = I; the axial Lorentzian transport gives return without erasure because ξₗᵢ𝒻ₜ(Lₐₓz) = ξₗᵢ𝒻ₜ(z) + 2 log φ while qₐₓ(ξₗᵢ𝒻ₜ(Lₐₓz)) = qₐₓ(ξₗᵢ𝒻ₜ(z)). [MM.0b, MM.5–MM.8]
cards.result: One quotient reading returns across two distinct ordered lift coordinates. H Lₐₓ H = Lₐₓ⁻¹, and Rₙ₊₁ = snoc(Rₙ, rₙ₊₁) preserves every occurrence at its own address.

cards.title: Time Scope
cards.relation: Linear electromagnetic polarization and a Pauli two-level state realize the same projective double cover: Uπz = −z while Scope(Uπz) = Scope(z), and Vα = e⁻ⁱασz reads (⟨σx⟩, ⟨σy⟩) = (cos 2α, sin 2α). [TS.5, TS.20–TS.22]
cards.result: The phase difference is Δα = ωΔt − k·Δx. A polarizer and Bloch read each return the projective direction while the local phase continues through the turn.

cards.title: Horizon Silence
cards.equation: dUₜₕ = TₜₕdSₜₕ − p dV + ⋯,  hᵢⱼₖ = 0 ⇔ dᵢⱼ = sⱼ − sᵢ
cards.relation: A viable thermodynamic trajectory obeys dUₜₕ = TₜₕdSₜₕ − p dV + ⋯ and dᵢSₜₕ ≥ 0; its eight-address relation ledger closes exactly when hᵢⱼₖ = 0 ⇔ dᵢⱼ = sⱼ − sᵢ, with 21 independent triangle conditions. [HS.3–HS.4, HS.22–HS.23]
cards.result: The horizon is ℋₕₒᵣ = ∂𝒱; silence is a completed occurrence with zero residual. Seven matchings factor all 28 relations of K₈ into the common field.
